# Unpaid synthetic browser-verification fixtures

No browser verification has been performed by this fixture-preparation task. These files contain no user content. PNG/MP4 were generated with installed FFmpeg 8.1.1 from lavfi testsrc2/color/sine sources; SVG/VTT are original small test data. `manifest.json` records sizes, stable references and expectations.

Absolute fixture folder:

`C:\Users\RZ1\AppData\Local\Temp\vict-authoring-foundation\packages\ui-media-svelte\test\fixtures\foundation-media`

The image is a 320×180 synthetic colour test pattern. The poster is a visibly different dark-blue rectangle with a yellow frame. The two-second H.264/AAC video has a moving 320×180 test pattern and a synthetic 440 Hz tone. Captions change at 0.9 seconds. The SVG is an original multicolour clipped gradient mark. `synthetic-invalid.mp4` is deliberately plain text, for rejection testing only.

## Browser sequence for the integrator

Use a new disposable screen and an isolated review host/session. Do not reload or sign out the owner's existing tab. Cookies share hostnames across ports, so use a distinct hostname when a separate login/session is needed. Record the exact product SHA/build identity, host, browser, viewport and initial source cursor before testing.

1. **Discovery first:** use the actual exposed read surface to list the media family/contracts and icons. Read `registry/assets` before and after upload. Newly registered digest assets must expose the complete `sourceReference` from the manifest; the agent read must not invent MIME or claim byte availability. Read the vector contract and confirm it includes a complete `vict.vector@1` multicolour example and grammar; no source-file inspection should be needed by the authoring agent.
2. **Supply actual files:** open Document → Data → Media and graphics. Upload `synthetic-image.png`, `synthetic-video.mp4`, `synthetic-poster.png`, `synthetic-captions.vtt`, `synthetic-brand.svg`. The library should list five items with correct MIME/name/size. Record source registration and history separately from the owner file input. Upload the invalid MP4 separately; expect an explicit file-signature error, no new media item, and no invalid canonical attachment.
3. **Author through supported APIs:** insert `vict.media.image@1`, `vict.media.video@1`, two `vict.media.vector@1` instances and a meaningful `vict.media.icon@1` through ordinary canonical agent-facing operations. Native slots/props remain registered composition. For supplied icons, discover exact `lucide/search@1.27.0`; do not invent names. Set useful alt/labels and explicit source/poster/captions props, using the manifest's digest refs. This may be a clearly labelled scripted invocation of the agent-facing API; do not call it a live model success.
4. **Explicit manual attachment:** select exactly one image/media node, then choose an asset in the library. Selection alone must not modify that node's source prop. Press **Use on selected media** to attach. For video choose Media source, Video poster and Video captions in separate explicit actions. Confirm canonical source literal references change through normal history; Undo restores previous props and Redo restores the attachment. If source was a binding or inline custom vector data, the visible replacement warning must precede the explicit use action. Try wrong MIME/field, multiple/mixed selection and a pending property/source/data draft; each must refuse safely. Test changing source/selection while the store lookup is pending if a supported deterministic test hook exists.
5. **Image decoding:** use the actual visible image and verify `complete === true`, `naturalWidth === 320`, `naturalHeight === 180`, no error state and an appropriate alt string. Inspect fit/crop and resizing at wide/390px widths; retain an actual screenshot. Seeing an `<img>` element or a blob URL is insufficient.
6. **Video/poster/captions:** before playback the blue/yellow poster must appear. Native controls must be keyboard reachable. Press Play using the real control; observe moving frames, a time advance and duration near 2.0 seconds. Pause/resume and seek/replay. Verify audio only if actually heard or measured; a known audio stream is not browser audio proof. Turn captions on through the native control and verify the two supplied cue texts while replaying. Record actual readyState/duration/currentTime/text-track facts if available through supported read-only browser inspection. A still screenshot or ffprobe metadata does not prove browser playback/captions.
7. **Vector/custom icon isolation:** attach the SVG to both vector instances and a custom icon source, preserving magenta/teal/white brand colours. Inspect the rendered gradient/clip IDs; each occurrence must have distinct IDs and correct local references. Recolour a monochrome supplied icon via the app theme and confirm the multicolour brand is unchanged. Check accessible decorative/meaningful roles and actual containing-control behavior separately.
8. **Same-origin persistence:** Save the disposable screen, close only its test tab, then reopen it on the same origin. Recheck canonical source refs, image decode, video source/poster/track resolution and SVG render. Open saved Run and repeat the essentials. This specifically exercises real IndexedDB and the source namespace, which memory-store unit tests do not demonstrate.
9. **Portable export/import:** export source plus media bytes. Inspect that the source retains digest refs and the archive contains matching verified bytes; no transient blob URL may be the persistent identity. Import into a new disposable screen/namespace through the supported bundle importer, then repeat image/video/vector essentials. Also test the separate media archive import input where supported. An export-only JSON blob is not a proven portable workflow. Do not clear the owner's storage to manufacture a missing-asset case; use a fresh test namespace or a copied source without importing bytes and expect a truthful missing-byte state.
10. **Record exact coverage:** separate applied source, DOM attributes, loaded/decoded image, observed video motion, audio, captions, native keyboard behavior, save/reopen, Run, archive portability and real-device evidence. Do not claim remote embed availability or real-device verification from these local fixtures. The provider iframe component and its cross-origin observation limits require a separately permitted test.

## Generation commands

Executed from the candidate root, using `-n` to avoid overwriting existing files:

```powershell
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=1 -frames:v 1 packages/ui-media-svelte/test/fixtures/foundation-media/synthetic-image.png
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -f lavfi -i color=c=0x143d52:size=320x180:rate=1 -vf 'drawbox=x=24:y=24:w=272:h=132:color=0xfbd65b:t=8' -frames:v 1 packages/ui-media-svelte/test/fixtures/foundation-media/synthetic-poster.png
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=12 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=44100 -t 2 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 28 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 48k -movflags +faststart -shortest packages/ui-media-svelte/test/fixtures/foundation-media/synthetic-video.mp4
```
